meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把一份文档交给它,会生成一套 kawaii 风格的 NotebookLM 幻灯片 PDF,落在源文件旁边,文件名带 -slides。若配好服务器环境变量,还会上传并返回一个手机版分享链接。
howto.when: 当你说「wowerpoint 这份文件」「给这份报告做成幻灯片」等,或想把某一份文档变成可分享的叙事幻灯片时触发。只处理单独一份源文档。

say.note: 开始生成幻灯片 PDF,约需 10 分钟

say.text: 把这份文档做成幻灯片
say.note: PDF 输出到源文件旁边,文件名带 -slides

say.text: 用可爱角色把这个文件的故事讲成幻灯片
say.note: 你的描述会原样作为生成提示词

howto.what_en: It turns a single document into a kawaii-styled NotebookLM slide-deck PDF, saved beside the source as <name>-slides.pdf. If the WOWerpoint server env vars are set, it also uploads the deck and returns a mobile share link.
howto.when_en: Use when you say "wowerpoint this", ask to make a deck about a file, or want one document turned into shareable narrative slides. Only one source document is handled.

say_en.note: Starts generating a slide-deck PDF, about 10 minutes
PDF lands next to the source, name ends in -slides

say_en.text: Use kawaii characters to tell this file's story as slides
say_en.note: Your wording is passed straight to the generator
